resources.string: Embedding model, backend support and index
Vector Search ranks project files by meaning, using the AI backend selected in AI settings to embed your code.
AI Core isn\'t installed or enabled. Install AI Core and an AI backend plugin such as Gemini or OpenAI to use Vector Search.
No AI backend is selected. Choose one that supports Vector Search, such as Gemini or OpenAI, in AI settings.
The selected backend, %1$s, isn\'t installed or enabled. Enable its plugin, or select another backend in AI settings.

%1$s doesn\'t support Vector Search, or its plugin is too old to offer its embedding models here. Update the %1$s plugin, or select a backend that supports it, such as Gemini or OpenAI, in AI settings.
Couldn\'t load the embedding models. Check the backend\'s API key and your network connection.
This backend lists no embedding models. Type the model\'s name instead.
Changing the model rebuilds the index on the next search.
The next search rebuilds the index with %1$s.
Indexing sends this project\'s source code to %1$s.
The first search in this project builds its index.
The last build stopped on an error, so nothing was stored. Check the backend\'s API key and quota, then clear the index so the next search tries again.
Built with %1$s. The next search rebuilds it with %2$s.
Searches use this index only while a backend that supports Vector Search is selected.
This clears the index for every project, not just the open one. The next search rebuilds it, which sends the project\'s source code to the selected backend again.
